lines.text: Ahh. (sighs) What a lovely little board.
Aww. Look at us. All squished together.
No rush, friend. No rush at all.
Sending you good vibes! Can you feel them?
Aww, you're doing great, you know.
One slide at a time. That's the secret.
Wait. Wait wait wait. I see it!
Ooh, ooh! Eleven ways out! Ten are bad!
I did the math. We win. Probably.
Okay, small problem. Big problem. Medium problem.
Eighty percent correct. Not bad, human.
(gasps) A gap! Did you see the gap?
Physics says I should slide. Interesting.
I made a chart! It's very blue.
Wake me when it's my turn. (yawns)
Nooo, not me. Pick someone else.
I'm not lazy. I'm saving energy.
The corner's comfy. I live here now.
Do I have to slide? Can I just roll?
Wake me if we win. Or don't.
Ooh ooh ooh! Pick me! Pick me!
Is it my turn? Now? NOW? (giggles)
Let's go let's go let's go!
Whoa! Did you see that? Again again!
Three sugar cubes. Is that a lot? (giggles)
I'm so excited I could POP!
I'm calm. Totally calm. Not calm! (giggles)
Hmph! One does not shove the Duchess.
I do hope the exit has a red carpet.
My grandmother was a castle brick, you know.
I shall not be rushed, darling.
Someone fetch me a tiny crown.
A queen never panics. She glides. Hmph!
I am not stuck. I am waiting regally.
Grr! Who put that wall there?!
Don't look at me. This is just my face.
One more bump and I'm gonna LOSE it!
(groans) Too many blocks. Not enough board.
Nobody tell me to calm down!
Hmph. I could solve this with my eyes closed.
Bix, darling. How long until I'm free?
Four moves. Give or take seven.
Fun fact. Orange is the hottest colour.
Is that a joke about me?
Pebble. How are you always calm?
Fun fact. Bricks have no knees.
Who wants to play I spy?
If we all move at once...
Don't be absurd. Everyone likes ME best.
When I leave, I expect a parade.
I'll be the parade! Bah bah bah!
One day, I'll be first out.
And we'll be so happy for you.
Cool. Wake me at the end.
Second tries are the magic ones.
Round two. You know the board now.
A tricky one. Slow and steady.
Don't panic! I'll panic for you!
Okay. That was fast. Don't brag.
Hmph! Not bad. Not bad at all!
Close one! But you made it.
Close! But a win is a win!
Too exciting. I need a nap.
You nearly gave me a meltdown!
We did it! We did it!
So close. The math was right there.
One more! We needed ONE more!
Time's up? I wasn't going anywhere.
That's okay! Next time we zoom!
We shall pretend that never happened.
Now THAT is how it's done.
Easy, friend. One at a time.
Wheee! Wait. Where are we going?
Must you shuffle us like furniture?
Stop dragging me back and forth!
Find the block nearest its colour.
We seem to be at an impasse.
Ooh, a break. I love breaks.
Lots of time. Can we slow down?
At this rate... we won't make it!
Uh oh. Even I can tell.
Come on come on come on!
Under a minute. You can do it.
Less than a minute! Go go go!
Under a minute?! Okay, I'm awake!
Ten seconds. You can do it!
Lots of undos. Pause and look?
So many undos. So much effort.
Pick a move and STICK with it!
Can it pull me out too?
Ooh, the easy way. I like it.
That's one way to solve it!
Please never do that to me.
Ha! That felt great. For me.
Do warn me before you rearrange the court!
